issues.detail: The Greek 'μολις' (molis) in this context functions as 'scarcely' or 'hardly' (expressing rarity), not 'hầu như' (almost/nearly). The Vietnamese translation implies a high frequency of death for the righteous, whereas the Greek emphasizes how rare it is.
The Greek 'ταχα' (tacha) expresses 'perhaps' or 'maybe,' which is omitted in the Vietnamese translation.
